# CellStyle

```csharp
public sealed class CellStyle
```

Namespace `SharpCell` · package `SharpCell`

How a cell looks in Excel: font, fill, borders and alignment. The number format is not part of it; see [Cell.NumberFormat](SharpCell.Cell.md#numberformat). Styles play no part in calculation. A record: styles compare by value, and `with` makes a changed copy, such as `style with { Fill = CellColor.FromRgb(0xFFFF00) }`.

<a id="horizontalalignment"></a>
### HorizontalAlignment

```csharp
public CellHorizontalAlignment HorizontalAlignment { get; init; }
```

Where the text sits across the cell. [CellHorizontalAlignment.General](SharpCell.CellHorizontalAlignment.md#general) is Excel's default: numbers right, text left, logical values and errors in the middle.

<a id="indent"></a>
### Indent

```csharp
public int Indent { get; init; }
```

The indent, in steps of the width of three characters of the default font; 0 to 250.

**Exceptions**

- `ArgumentOutOfRangeException`: The indent is outside 0 to 250.
